analysis_refs.heading: 3. Discovery engines to use before broad web searching
analysis_refs.text: | [SciELO country collections](https://www.scielo.org/en/) and [LA Referencia](https://www.lareferencia.info/en/home) | Regional discovery across Latin America and other participating research communities | A supported external query route for our application without further investigation |

evidence_storage_note: Public Spain record IDs use JSON Unicode escaping for their initial E because ES_ plus32hex collides with GitHub hCaptcha-secret patterns. Parsed native IDs/URLs are unchanged; no credentials or access-control bypass. Raw search-page markup is omitted; parsed bibliographic outputs and original response hashes are retained.
